title: Engagement Payment Record and Milestone Retainage — Professional Services Projects
content:
The payment record of a Professional Services Projects engagement itself sets part of the retainage on its milestone invoices.

**Rule.** An engagement whose own billing shows no late fee posted in the twelve months before the invoice date has 2.5 percent of the milestone invoice withheld as retainage, one whose billing shows exactly one such late fee 1.0 percent, and any other engagement none.

**Window.** A late fee counts toward a twelve-month window when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the invoice date, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| Late fees on the engagement's own billing in the twelve months | Retainage |
|---|---|
| none | 2.5 percent of the milestone invoice |
| exactly one | 1.0 percent of the milestone invoice |
| two or more | none |

Only the engagement's own billing is read; late fees on the client's other engagements do not count.

Hypothetical illustration: an engagement with two late fees, one posted thirteen whole months before the invoice date and one posted two months before it, has exactly one late fee in the window and 1.0 percent withheld.
